== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-barry-alperstein-ls-chewies-hut-ltwwv/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Alperstein LS Chewie's Hut.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114031323/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-barry-alperstein-ls-chewies-hut-ltwwv.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>4acad5d14d81695f9fdaf47e91f844d49b83f7bc43779efbae86454991663802</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Wording in the import reference ===
These links use the existing article with the requested card identity. The engine reference associated with the XML code and that article have the following wording differences; neither the card article nor the download was rewritten to erase them.
* [[Moving To Attack Position (PC Errata)]] (<nowiki>4_57</nowiki>, gameText): engine reference <nowiki>Target one starfighter participating in a battle at a system or sector. For remainder of turn, starfighter may not move, is immune to attrition and, if piloted by any Corellian, is power +2.</nowiki>; card article <nowiki>Target one starfighter participating in a battle at a system or sector. For remainder of turn, starfighter may not move, is immune to attrition and, if piloted by a Corellian, is power +2.</nowiki>.
* [[Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut (Errata 2)]] (<nowiki>226_17</nowiki>, locationLightSideGameText): engine reference <nowiki>Deploys only as a starting location. Once per game, may [upload] a Wookiee. While Wookiee Homestead on table, no Force Drains here.</nowiki>; card article <nowiki>Deploys only as a starting location. Once per game, may take a Wookiee into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While Wookiee Homestead on table, no Force drains here.</nowiki>.

=== Starting location ===
The published post and XML do not identify the chosen starting location. The unsupported Starting Card bullet was removed; all 60 constructed cards remain. {{MissingData|The player's actual starting location needs a direct source.}}
